planets.name: WASP-63 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kosjenka with a 4.38-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: WASP-63 b was found in 2012 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kosjenka. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
